skill.summary: Helps non-technical users create their own Skills through natural conversation. Triggers when users say "I want to create a Skill", "turn this workflow into...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — skill-builder 1.0.0

- Guides non-technical users through creating custom Skills via natural conversation.
- Uses step-by-step questions and real-life examples to draw out user needs without jargon.
- Automatically generates a ready-to-use SKILL.md, summarizing agreed rules and output format.
- Includes safeguards for quality by silently checking each Skill against a bundled checklist before delivery.
- Offers users a simple method to test their new Skills after installation, with clear, non-technical guidance.
